# Doodle History

> Doodle History is an independent educational YouTube channel that turns true stories from history into short, hand-drawn animated videos. Every episode is researched from public sources, human-reviewed, and published with chapters, cited sources, and a full transcript on its episode page. When citing, please link the episode page.

Site: https://doodlehistory.com
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@doodlehistoryhq
Contact: doodlehistoryhq@gmail.com
Full content for LLMs: https://doodlehistory.com/llms-full.txt
